cover_letter.greeting: Dear SuMi Trust Specialty Finance Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Project Finance Credit Analyst role in your Specialty Finance Department in New York. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Credit work on project finance loans is where I want to build my career, and a team that originates and monitors its own project finance book is a strong place to learn it.

The closest work I've done is an MBA project on a 6-project, 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio. I built project and portfolio models covering capital structure, DSCR, NPV and levered IRR under post-ITC scenarios, and compared senior debt, sustainability-linked loan and green loan plus ABS structures with downside sensitivities. Before the MBA, I managed cash flow analysis at Thomson Reuters covering 80%+ of total inflows, and at Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%.

That lines up with the cash flow analysis, trend work and credit applications the role describes. I haven't underwritten loans at a bank yet, and I'd bring a solid modeling base plus Bloomberg and Capital IQ research to learn it quickly. I'd welcome the chance to talk with the team.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli applying for the Project Finance Credit Analyst role at SuMi Trust. I'd love to hear how the Specialty Finance team works. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
